extension codepunk-tui hidden=true
on session_start
on model_select
on thinking_level_select
on agent_start
on agent_settled
on session_shutdown
registerToolRenderer
registerCommand help	Search, browse, and run Codepunk commands
registerCommand init	Create or update AGENTS.md from repository evidence
registerCommand diff	Show staged and unstaged working tree changes
registerCommand undo	Restore recent Codepunk write/edit changes
registerCommand redo	Reapply changes removed by /undo
registerCommand commit	Review and create a Git commit as a human action
registerCommand status	Show model, session, permission, trust, and usage status
registerCommand cp-sessions	List codepunk sessions
registerCommand plan	Show, enter, approve, or exit plan mode, or plan a request read-only
registerCommand goal	Create or manage the goal that survives turns
registerCommand hooks	Show lifecycle hook evidence
registerCommand preset	List or apply a user preset to this session
registerCommand btw	Run a read-only side question without stopping the main task
registerCommand recap	Show a derived recap for a contiguous session range
registerCommand image	Confirm an image and send it with the next prompt
registerCommand image-gen	Generate an image through an available image model
registerCommand roles	Show configured model roles and subagent pools
registerCommand review	Review the current diff with structured findings
registerCommand todos	Show the current todo list
registerCommand context	Visualize context window token usage and breakdown
registerCommand evidence	Inspect current run evidence ledger
registerCommand attest	Generate a PR-ready Markdown verification summary
registerCommand models	Select a recent or favorite model
registerCommand favorite	Toggle the current model in favorites
registerShortcut f2	Cycle through recent models
registerShortcut alt+m	Cycle work mode (plan/standard/auto/auto-approve)
registerShortcut alt+t	Open the unified task and subagent center
registerShortcut alt+r	Open the interactive rewind picker
registerShortcut alt+k	Open the interactive command palette
registerShortcut alt+g	Compose or edit prompt in external editor
registerShortcut alt+s	Stash or restore editor prompt draft
registerShortcut f1	Open searchable command help
registerCommand budget	Show model token and cost usage against the budget
registerCommand doctor	Run codepunk doctor diagnostics
registerCommand policy	Show effective codepunk policy
registerCommand capabilities	List MCP servers, skills, and plugins
registerCommand skills	Inspect loaded skills and reload
registerCommand plugins	Inspect plugins, toggle enablement, or reload
registerCommand mcp	List, sign in to, or inspect user MCP servers
registerCommand permissions	Show or change approval, autonomy, and sandbox modes
registerCommand cp-export	Export a redacted audit transcript
registerCommand subagent	Start a background child Pi session
registerCommand agents	Review, sign, merge, or discard background subagents
registerCommand tasks	Open the unified interactive task and subagent center
registerCommand rewind	Interactively rewind recent file checkpoints and/or conversation branches
registerCommand ps	List background tasks
registerCommand logs	Show bounded background task logs
registerCommand stop	Stop a background task
registerCommand sign	Sign the current settled run
registerCommand remember	Remember a user or project fact
registerCommand memory	List, search, delete, or archive memory
registerCommand copy	Copy the latest assistant reply or code block to clipboard
registerCommand editor	Compose or edit the current prompt in $VISUAL/$EDITOR
registerCommand run	Run or list custom Markdown prompt templates (/run [list|<name> [args...]])
registerCommand stash	Stash or restore prompt drafts in the editor (Alt+S)
registerCommand learn	Distill session corrections into AGENTS.md or project memory with diff review
